Name: Macaron Silos for Alternative Textures
Author: NaoeaDri
Description:
[size=3][img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/899735355094343750/1077633114383319080/how-to-install.png[/img]

[/size]1. Download [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
2. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]
3. Download this mod and unzip in your mods folder
4. Run the game using SMAPI


[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/899735355094343750/1077647214953910292/macaron-silos.png[/img]

[size=2]This mod visually transforms the silos, which store the straw for the animals, into giant piles of colorful macarons.
The stacks of macarons are available in 6 variations, each having a bright or pastel version, for a total of 12 different textures.[/size]


[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/899735355094343750/1077643674445430794/how-to-use.png[/img]
[size=2]
To use the mod, you'll first need the Paint Bucket which is sold at Robin's Carpentry Shop, along with the other tools from the Alternative Textures mod. Then all you have to do is click with the paint bucket on the silo which you want to turn into a giant pile of macarons, and then a menu will appear with all the options for you to choose from, just click on what you like the most and the job is done.[/size]

Downloads.Description: Unzip the file in your mods folder.
